title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and bump versions (py/ts/go)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) diverged in auth token refresh behavior, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies semantics across SDKs to reduce surprising behavior for users and make platform-level retries/circuit-breakers more predictable. Work included: 1) extract a shared auth middleware pattern and standardize token refresh + automatic retry on auth failures, 2) converge retry/backoff default (exponential backoff with full jitter, maxRetries=5, base=100ms, cap=10s), 3) bring streaming API parity: Python exposes a context-manager/iterator-based stream, TS exposes async-iterator + event-based callback, Go exposes an iterator-like Reader with Cancel context, 4) add integration tests for streaming and auth edge-cases, 5) bump SDK versions to capture compatibility and publish notes. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-3121) - [x] implementation across py/ts/go - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and changelogs updated - [x] bump versions and release notes Commits summary: see commits field. High-level files changed: see files_changed field. Testing notes: some flaky integration tests on initial run (streaming e2e against local canary) were addressed by adding deterministic delays and more robust test harness; CI green on final run. Merge strategy: squash merge to keep history compact and ensure release PR contains single changelog entry. Release: SDK releases staged, publishing pipeline triggered after merge.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please use exponential backoff with full jitter per AWS best practices; prefer default maxRetries=5. Fixed in retries.strategy.go and documented in docs.
Priya Desai: Ensure token refresh is fully backwards compatible with existing sync/async flows in Python. Added adapter and regression tests for both sync and async token providers.
Marco Li: Add integration test that simulates token expiry mid-stream and ensure client gracefully recovers or fails with clear error. Added test + improved logging.
Ava Martinez (author): Responded to comments, pushed follow-up commits addressing backoff params, test flakiness, and added a migration note for users upgrading from older SDK versions.

release_notes: Unified SDK auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Key changes: standardized retry/backoff defaults, context-manager and iterator-based streaming APIs, improved token refresh compatibility, and minor API ergonomics. Bumped SDK versions: python 1.9.0, typescript 2.4.0, go 0.7.0. See docs/sdk-migration.md for migration notes.
notes_for_releasers: After merge, the publishing pipeline will run. Monitor canary for the first 24 hours for streaming-related latencies. Notify SDK channels and update CDN assets. Changelog entry generated; coordinate with docs team for website update.
migration_guidance: Users should: 1) review SDK migration notes in docs/sdk-migration.md, 2) update retry configuration only if they relied on previous defaults, 3) adjust streaming consumer code: Python users should prefer 'with client.stream() as s:' pattern or iterate over s, TS users can use for-await-of on the stream async iterator, Go users should use the provided StreamingReader and respect context cancellation. Backwards compatibility shims included for common patterns.
